newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity options volume hits record in January.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity options volume hits record in January.

text.p: U.S. equity options volume in January reached a record 23,001,365 contracts, the Options Industry Council said Wednesday.
January volume was 23 percent higher than the January 1996 level of 18,698,894 and 19 percent above the prior monthly record of 19,326,489 contracts set in October 1996.
Average daily volume in January was 1,045,517 contracts, the industry group said.
